rows.title: Probability calibration, official documentation
rows.evidence: Brier and log loss assess reliability, resolution and uncertainty together; lower Brier loss alone does not necessarily mean better calibration.
rows.supports: Proper-score terminology and the need for reliability diagrams/binning, not a calibration-only claim.
rows.does_not_support: NBA predictive performance or a betting edge.

rows.title: Confidence Limits for the Mean
rows.evidence: Confidence is associated with the interval-producing method; more observations and less variability generally yield more precise estimates.
rows.supports: General uncertainty reporting and its interpretation.
rows.does_not_support: An IID assumption for same-game bets, a bootstrap guarantee, or removal of luck.

rows.title: Bonferroni's method
rows.evidence: Bonferroni's method makes multiple comparison statements while maintaining an overall confidence coefficient for a finite, preselected family.
rows.supports: Conservative family-wise error control across the frozen candidate family.
rows.does_not_support: Protection from undisclosed adaptive searches or confirmation of an NBA edge.

rows.title: scipy.stats.binomtest
rows.evidence: Official SciPy reference for the exact binomial test of a success probability.
rows.supports: The numerical test implementation; independent Bernoulli trials are an assumption, not a property of correlated parlays.
rows.does_not_support: Use of a naive binomial test as the sole gate for clustered betting returns.
